CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `email_canonical` varchar(254) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `email_display` varchar(254) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `display_name` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `locale` varchar(35) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `is_platform_admin` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `email_verified_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `auth_epoch` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `email_canonical` (`email_canonical`),
  KEY `users_list_idx` (`created_at` DESC,`id` DESC),
  KEY `users_status_list_idx` (`status`,`created_at` DESC,`id` DESC),
  CONSTRAINT `users_chk_2` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'active',_utf8mb4'disabled'))),
  CONSTRAINT `users_chk_3` CHECK ((`is_platform_admin` in (0,1))),
  CONSTRAINT `users_chk_4` CHECK ((`auth_epoch` between 1 and 9007199254740991)),
  CONSTRAINT `users_chk_5` CHECK ((`version` between 1 and 9007199254740991)),
  CONSTRAINT `users_chk_6` CHECK ((`email_canonical` = lower(`email_canonical`))),
  CONSTRAINT `users_id_canonical` CHECK (regexp_like(`id`,_ascii'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c')),
  CONSTRAINT `users_locale_check` CHECK (regexp_like(`locale`,_utf8mb4'^[a-z]{2,3}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8}){0,3}$',_utf8mb4'c'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE `invitations` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `tenant_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `workspace_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `email_canonical` varchar(254) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `locale` varchar(35) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `role` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
  `status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `token_hash` varbinary(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `token_generation` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `created_by` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `accepted_user_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `accepted_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `revoked_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `pending_email` varchar(254) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`status` = _utf8mb4'pending') then `email_canonical` else NULL end)) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `token_hash` (`token_hash`),
  UNIQUE KEY `invitations_pending_email_idx` (`pending_email`),
  KEY `invitations_list_idx` (`created_at` DESC,`id` DESC),
  KEY `created_by` (`created_by`),
  KEY `accepted_user_id` (`accepted_user_id`),
  KEY `tenant_id` (`tenant_id`,`workspace_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`accepted_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`, `workspace_id`) REFERENCES `workspaces` (`tenant_id`, `id`),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_10` CHECK ((((`status` = _utf8mb4'accepted') and (`accepted_user_id` is not null) and (`accepted_at` is not null)) or ((`status` <> _utf8mb4'accepted') and (`accepted_user_id` is null) and (`accepted_at` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_11` CHECK (((`status` = _utf8mb4'revoked') = (`revoked_at` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_2` CHECK ((`role` = _utf8mb4'member')),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_3` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'pending',_utf8mb4'accepted',_utf8mb4'revoked',_utf8mb4'expired'))),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_4` CHECK (((`token_hash` is null) or (length(`token_hash`) = 32))),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_5` CHECK ((`token_generation` >= 1)),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_6` CHECK ((`version` between 1 and 9007199254740991)),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_7` CHECK ((`email_canonical` = lower(`email_canonical`))),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_8` CHECK ((`expires_at` > `created_at`)),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_9` CHECK (((`status` = _utf8mb4'pending') = (`token_hash` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_id_canonical` CHECK (regexp_like(`id`,_ascii'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c')),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_locale_check` CHECK (regexp_like(`locale`,_utf8mb4'^[a-z]{2,3}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8}){0,3}$',_utf8mb4'c'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE `mail_deliveries` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `purpose` varchar(24) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `recipient_email` varchar(254) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `locale` varchar(35) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `invitation_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `invitation_generation` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `reset_token_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `user_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `state` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `payload_key_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `payload_nonce` varbinary(12) DEFAULT NULL,
  `payload_ciphertext` blob,
  `payload_schema_version` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `attempt_count` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `next_attempt_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `lease_token` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `locked_until` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `error_category` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `message_id` varchar(254) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `completed_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `message_id` (`message_id`),
  KEY `mail_claim_idx` (`state`,`next_attempt_at`),
  KEY `mail_list_idx` (`created_at` DESC,`id` DESC),
  KEY `invitation_id` (`invitation_id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `reset_token_id` (`reset_token_id`,`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`invitation_id`) REFERENCES `invitations` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`reset_token_id`, `user_id`) REFERENCES `password_reset_tokens` (`id`, `user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_chk_1` CHECK ((`purpose` in (_utf8mb4'invitation',_utf8mb4'password_reset',_utf8mb4'password_changed'))),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_chk_3` CHECK ((`state` in (_utf8mb4'queued',_utf8mb4'sending',_utf8mb4'sent',_utf8mb4'failed',_utf8mb4'cancelled'))),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_chk_4` CHECK ((`payload_schema_version` = 1)),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_chk_5` CHECK ((`attempt_count` between 0 and 5)),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_chk_6` CHECK ((((`purpose` = _utf8mb4'invitation') and (`invitation_id` is not null) and (`invitation_generation` is not null) and (`reset_token_id` is null) and (`user_id` is null)) or ((`purpose` = _utf8mb4'password_reset') and (`reset_token_id` is not null) and (`invitation_id` is null) and (`invitation_generation` is null) and (`user_id` is not null)) or ((`purpose` = _utf8mb4'password_changed') and (`user_id` is not null) and (`invitation_id` is null) and (`invitation_generation` is null) and (`reset_token_id` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_chk_7` CHECK ((((`state` in (_utf8mb4'queued',_utf8mb4'sending')) and (`payload_key_id` is not null) and (`payload_nonce` is not null) and (length(`payload_nonce`) = 12) and (`payload_ciphertext` is not null) and (`completed_at` is null)) or ((`state` in (_utf8mb4'sent',_utf8mb4'failed',_utf8mb4'cancelled')) and (`payload_key_id` is null) and (`payload_nonce` is null) and (`payload_ciphertext` is null) and (`completed_at` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_chk_8` CHECK ((((`state` = _utf8mb4'sending') and (`lease_token` is not null) and (`locked_until` is not null)) or ((`state` <> _utf8mb4'sending') and (`lease_token` is null) and (`locked_until` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_id_canonical` CHECK (regexp_like(`id`,_ascii'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c')),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_locale_check` CHECK (regexp_like(`locale`,_utf8mb4'^[a-z]{2,3}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8}){0,3}$',_utf8mb4'c')),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_lease_canonical` CHECK (((`lease_token` is null) or regexp_like(`lease_token`,_ascii'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE `sso_connectors` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `tenant_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `provider` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `origin` varchar(2048) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `client_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `secret_key_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `secret_nonce` varbinary(12) NOT NULL,
  `secret_ciphertext` varbinary(4112) NOT NULL,
  `enabled` tinyint(1) NOT NULL,
  `revision` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `auth_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `created_by` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `sso_connectors_tenant_identity` (`tenant_id`,`id`),
  KEY `sso_connectors_page_idx` (`tenant_id`,`created_at` DESC,`id` DESC),
  KEY `created_by` (`created_by`),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_connectors_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`) REFERENCES `tenants` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_connectors_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_client_id_canonical` CHECK (regexp_like(`client_id`,_utf8mb4'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c')),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_connectors_chk_1` CHECK ((char_length(trim(`name`)) > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_connectors_chk_2` CHECK ((`provider` = _utf8mb4'gitea')),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_connectors_chk_3` CHECK ((length(`secret_nonce`) = 12)),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_connectors_chk_4` CHECK ((length(`secret_ciphertext`) between 17 and 4112)),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_connectors_chk_5` CHECK ((`enabled` in (0,1))),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_connectors_chk_6` CHECK ((`revision` between 1 and 9007199254740991)),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_connectors_chk_7` CHECK ((`auth_version` between 1 and 9007199254740991)),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_connectors_id_canonical` CHECK (regexp_like(`id`,_utf8mb4'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE `sso_bindings` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `tenant_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `connector_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `subject` varchar(19) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `user_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `revision` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `sso_bindings_subject` (`tenant_id`,`connector_id`,`subject`),
  UNIQUE KEY `sso_bindings_user_identity` (`tenant_id`,`connector_id`,`id`,`user_id`),
  KEY `sso_bindings_user_idx` (`tenant_id`,`user_id`,`created_at`,`id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_bindings_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`, `connector_id`) REFERENCES `sso_connectors` (`tenant_id`, `id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_bindings_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_bindings_chk_1` CHECK ((`active` in (0,1))),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_bindings_chk_2` CHECK ((`revision` between 1 and 9007199254740991)),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_bindings_id_canonical` CHECK (regexp_like(`id`,_utf8mb4'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c')),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_subject_domain` CHECK ((regexp_like(`subject`,_utf8mb4'^[1-9][0-9]{0,18}$',_utf8mb4'c') and (not(regexp_like(`subject`,_utf8mb4'[^0-9]',_utf8mb4'c'))) and ((char_length(`subject`) < 19) or (`subject` <= _utf8mb4'9223372036854775807'))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE `sso_flows` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `tenant_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `connector_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `connector_revision` bigint NOT NULL,
  `auth_version` bigint NOT NULL,
  `audience` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `mode` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `state` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `state_hash` varbinary(32) NOT NULL,
  `browser_hash` varbinary(32) NOT NULL,
  `previous_cookie_hash` varbinary(32) NOT NULL,
  `previous_session_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `initiating_user_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `initiating_session_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `initiating_epoch` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `credential_version` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `reason` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `verifier_key_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `verifier_nonce` varbinary(12) DEFAULT NULL,
  `verifier_ciphertext` varbinary(59) DEFAULT NULL,
  `claim_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `authenticated_user_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `issued_session_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `error_code` varchar(80) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `expires_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `finished_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `state_hash` (`state_hash`),
  UNIQUE KEY `sso_flows_tenant_identity` (`tenant_id`,`connector_id`,`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `sso_flows_user_identity` (`tenant_id`,`connector_id`,`id`,`authenticated_user_id`),
  KEY `sso_flows_expiry_idx` (`state`,`expires_at`,`id`),
  KEY `sso_flows_connector_idx` (`tenant_id`,`connector_id`,`state`),
  KEY `initiating_user_id` (`initiating_user_id`),
  KEY `authenticated_user_id` (`authenticated_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`, `connector_id`) REFERENCES `sso_connectors` (`tenant_id`, `id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`initiating_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`authenticated_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flow_error_state` CHECK ((((`state` in (_utf8mb4'failed',_utf8mb4'expired')) and (`error_code` is not null) and regexp_like(`error_code`,_utf8mb4'^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{1,79}$',_utf8mb4'c') and (not(regexp_like(`error_code`,_utf8mb4'[^A-Z0-9_]',_utf8mb4'c')))) or ((`state` not in (_utf8mb4'failed',_utf8mb4'expired')) and (`error_code` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flow_link_source` CHECK ((((`mode` = _utf8mb4'login') and (`initiating_user_id` is null) and (`initiating_session_id` is null) and (`initiating_epoch` is null) and (`credential_version` is null) and (`reason` is null)) or ((`mode` = _utf8mb4'link') and (`previous_session_id` is not null) and (`previous_session_id` = `initiating_session_id`) and (`initiating_user_id` is not null) and (`initiating_session_id` is not null) and (`initiating_epoch` is not null) and (`credential_version` is not null) and (`reason` is not null) and (`initiating_epoch` between 1 and 9007199254740991) and (`credential_version` between 1 and 9007199254740991) and (char_length(trim(`reason`)) between 1 and 500)))),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flow_verifier_state` CHECK ((((`state` = _utf8mb4'pending') and (`verifier_key_id` is not null) and (`verifier_nonce` is not null) and (length(`verifier_nonce`) = 12) and (`verifier_ciphertext` is not null) and (length(`verifier_ciphertext`) = 59) and (`claim_id` is null)) or ((`state` <> _utf8mb4'pending') and (`verifier_key_id` is null) and (`verifier_nonce` is null) and (`verifier_ciphertext` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_chk_1` CHECK ((`connector_revision` between 1 and 9007199254740991)),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_chk_10` CHECK (((`state` not in (_utf8mb4'claimed',_utf8mb4'succeeded')) or (`claim_id` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_chk_11` CHECK (((`state` = _utf8mb4'succeeded') = (`authenticated_user_id` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_chk_12` CHECK (((`state` = _utf8mb4'succeeded') or (`issued_session_id` is null))),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_chk_13` CHECK (((`state` in (_utf8mb4'succeeded',_utf8mb4'failed',_utf8mb4'expired')) = (`finished_at` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_chk_14` CHECK (((`previous_session_id` is null) or regexp_like(`previous_session_id`,_utf8mb4'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c'))),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_chk_15` CHECK (((`initiating_session_id` is null) or regexp_like(`initiating_session_id`,_utf8mb4'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c'))),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_chk_16` CHECK (((`claim_id` is null) or regexp_like(`claim_id`,_utf8mb4'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c'))),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_chk_17` CHECK (((`issued_session_id` is null) or regexp_like(`issued_session_id`,_utf8mb4'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c'))),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_chk_2` CHECK ((`auth_version` between 1 and 9007199254740991)),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_chk_3` CHECK ((`audience` in (_utf8mb4'portal',_utf8mb4'admin'))),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_chk_4` CHECK ((`mode` in (_utf8mb4'login',_utf8mb4'link'))),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_chk_5` CHECK ((`state` in (_utf8mb4'pending',_utf8mb4'claimed',_utf8mb4'succeeded',_utf8mb4'failed',_utf8mb4'expired'))),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_chk_6` CHECK ((length(`state_hash`) = 32)),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_chk_7` CHECK ((length(`browser_hash`) = 32)),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_chk_8` CHECK ((length(`previous_cookie_hash`) = 32)),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_chk_9` CHECK ((`expires_at` > `created_at`)),
  CONSTRAINT `sso_flows_id_canonical` CHECK (regexp_like(`id`,_utf8mb4'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE `sessions` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `user_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `audience` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `token_hash` varbinary(32) NOT NULL,
  `auth_epoch` bigint NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
